title: Guzzle
summary: GUZ'ZLE, verb intransitive To swallow liquor greedily; to drink much; to drink frequently. Well seasoned bowls the gossip's spirits raise, Who, while she guzzles, chats the Doctor's praise. GUZ'ZLE. v

inlines.v: GUZ'ZLE, verb intransitive To swallow liquor greedily; to drink much; to drink frequently. Well seasoned bowls the gossip's spirits raise, Who, while she guzzles, chats the Doctor's praise. GUZ'ZLE. verb transitive To swallow much or often; to swallow with immoderate gust. --Still guzzling must of wine. GUZ'ZLE, noun An insatiable thing or person.
